assessment_summary: At line 0297, the proof attempts to establish a dimension bound by induction on the interval from i to j. However, the summations incorrectly use the limits 0 <= k < j-i and 0 < k < j-i, while the summands remain indexed by k and k+1 (e.g., C_{k,k+1}) rather than being shifted by i. This causes the sum to evaluate entirely wrong terms (such as C_{0,1}, which is outside the relevant [i, j] range), rendering the inequality and this step mathematically invalid.
